business_problem: LG Electronics, a leader in global home appliances, has addressed many technological challenges over the years to provide better value to consumers. LG faced many difficulties along the way, such as large-capacity data management, information security and system expansion.
solution_summary: LG Electronics, a leader in global home appliances, has addressed many technological challenges over the years to provide better value to consumers. One example is LG’s recently launched “UP Home Appliances” service, which can continuously upgrade the functions of home appliances with self-developed artificial intelligence (AI) chips. To start this initiative, the home appliance company focused on the efficient use of their customer data and established a customer-centric data system. LG faced many difficulties along the way, such as large-capacity data management, information security and system expansion. But with the Databricks Data + AI Platform, they were able to streamline customer data management — reducing both the time to unify customer purchasing data and overall costs by 50%. LG Electronics is known for their innovative home appliances worldwide, with sales of their various products reaching approximately 100 million units every year.

solution_components.name: Databricks Data + AI Platform
solution_components.role: Provides the shared lakehouse environment for ingestion, engineering, analytics, and AI workloads.

solution_components.name: Databricks SQL
solution_components.role: Serves dashboards, self-service queries, and business intelligence for downstream users.

solution_components.name: Delta Lake
solution_components.role: Stores curated lakehouse tables used for reliable downstream analytics and AI workloads.

data_flow: Customer, product, and engagement data lands in Databricks, is transformed in Delta Lake tables, and is served to downstream users and applications through Databricks SQL.
business_outcome: Reported outcomes include 50% Reduction in existing total costs; 70% Reduction in processing times.
